Subject: Signature orbit — procurement gating & sequencing scenario

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the candid call this morning. Per our sync, I wanted to capture a concise mutual action plan that aligns legal/ procurement milestones with the evaluation run you have planned next month. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a draft order form so your procurement team can see the proposed commercial stub. Key points:

- High-level timeline: evaluation (3 weeks) -> security/ legal review (2 weeks) -> PO & signature (1 week).
- Known gating items: SOC 2 evidence, DPA language around data residency, and an explicit acceptance definition for pilot success.
- Who owns what: Lighthouse to run the technical pilot and produce acceptance notes; Redwood to deliver SOC2 pack and clean DPA redlines; Procurement to confirm PO cadence.

Can you confirm whether Procurement needs an internal review step (legal + vendor risk) before PO issuance and if they prefer the order form to be sent as a separate PDF for countersignature? If you share a target signature date I’ll align our SLA exceptions on Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: [Attachment: Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx (18KB)], [Attachment: RI_OrderForm_draft_20270921.pdf (24KB)]

Thanks —

Subject: Re: Signature orbit — procurement gating & sequencing scenario

Marcus / team —

Appreciate the map — quick legal read and a couple of blockers we need clarified before we can finalize DPA redlines:

1) Data residency: Lighthouse requires EU customer data to remain in EU regions for any analytics exports. Can you confirm hosting options for dedicated instances if the pilot ingests EU PHI?
2) Retention: the draft order form has a 90-day logs retention. For our audit we need a 365-day retention option and an archival path.
3) Subprocessors: please provide the current subprocessors list + SOC2 scope doc (we have an internal vendor-risk template).

If those items are covered, Legal can turn around redlines within 3 business days. Procurement tends to run vendor risk in parallel — Sanjay will confirm whether they raise a PO pre-signature or at signature.

Quick ask: can Redwood share a sanitized SOC2 pack (low-sensitivity evidence only) and a one-page compliance summary for our vendor portal?

Regards,
Maya R.
Legal Counsel, Lighthouse Health
maya.legal@lighthouse.health

Marcus, Laura —

Quick procurement update from our side: our internal vendor-risk intake will run alongside Legal but Procurement requires an itemized order form to route for budget approval. We aim to complete the budget authorization by Oct 18, which would make an optimistic signature window the week of Oct 25 (assuming legal redlines are resolved).

Notes from Procurement:
- They want the order form broken into two line items: pilot seat licenses + Dedicated capacity reserve (sizing estimate).
- PO timing: we typically issue PO at signature, but can provision an interim Vendor Engagement Letter if Redwood can hold pricing for 30 days.
- Acceptance definition: acceptance will be a short doc produced by our engineering lead (pass/fail checks + sample prompts).

I’ve attached an internal intake doc for the Procurement team to complete (fills our vendor portal fields). If you can provide the SOC2 overview and subprocessors list by EOD Thursday (Sep 23), that will keep our timeline intact.

Attachment: [Attachment: Lighthouse_vendor_intake_form.docx (12KB)]

Hi Sanjay / Maya —

Thanks for the clear asks. Short answers and next steps:

- Hosting/Residency: we can provision a Dedicated pool in eu-central-1 for any EU PHI during the pilot. That option will be explicitly called out in the order form line item for Dedicated capacity.
- Retention: we’ll add an archival clause and offer a 365-day logs retention option (configurable per account).
- Subprocessors + SOC2: attached a redacted SOC2 evidence summary and our subprocessors list; full SOC2 package will be uploaded to the drive link (sanitized).

I’ve also updated the MAP to include a hard milestone: Legal redlines due by Sep 24 EOD; Procurement budget auth by Oct 18; Target signature week: Oct 25. If any of those dates are unworkable, flag here and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2_evidence_summary.txt (6KB)], [Attachment: subprocessors_list.csv (3KB)], [Attachment: Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated) (20KB)]

Action items assigned:
- Redwood (Marcus): update order form to split pilot vs. Dedicated SKU and reissue by Sep 22 noon PT.
- Redwood (Karthik): prepare DPA redline baseline for Maya to edit — deliver Sep 23.
- Lighthouse (Procurement): complete vendor intake by Sep 23 to avoid slip.

We’ll stand up a short canary SLA exception during pilot provisioning so your team can test latency/throughput without delay.

Best,
